sections.Profile:
"Build Up" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Exhibit Supply Company in January 1948. Notably, it was the company's first game to feature flippers, marking a significant innovation in their pinball designs.

- Manufacturer: Exhibit Supply Company
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Wood Rail, Arts & Entertainment, Original Theme
